arrivalGuide.title: First hour after landing — Djerba–Zarzis (DJE)
arrivalGuide.summary: Immigration → bags → SIM/cash → official taxi or hotel transfer → hotel.

steps.title: Clear immigration
steps.description: Have passport ready. Follow arrivals signs.

steps.title: Collect bags
steps.description: Baggage belts are after immigration. Keep boarding pass handy if asked.

steps.title: SIM / eSIM if needed
steps.description: Operator desks in arrivals. Passport required for registration.

steps.title: Cash from ATM
steps.description: Withdraw TND for taxi and small purchases. Prefer bank ATMs when possible.

steps.title: Official taxi or hotel transfer
steps.description: Use the marked taxi rank or your pre-booked transfer. Agree fare before leaving if needed.

steps.title: Ride to hotel / first base
steps.description: Typical ride to Midoun / zone touristique is 25–45 minutes depending on traffic.

howToGuides.title: How louage works on Djerba
howToGuides.summary: Shared taxis from stations — cheap seats on known routes.

steps.title: Go to the louage station
steps.description: Houmt Souk and Midoun have main louage points.

steps.title: Say your destination
steps.description: Staff or drivers will point you to the right vehicle.

steps.title: Pay per seat when boarding
steps.description: Cash only. Vehicle leaves when seats fill.

howToGuides.title: 48h survival checklist — Djerba
howToGuides.summary: Cash, SIM, water, sunscreen, trusted taxi number from hotel.

steps.title: Get local cash + data
steps.description: ATM + SIM so maps and messages work offline of hotel Wi‑Fi.

steps.title: Save hotel + taxi contact
steps.description: Ask reception for a trusted driver number for night rides.

steps.title: Learn one food + one beach
steps.description: Pick a calm restaurant near your base and one beach for the first afternoon.
